integrity: The mathematical claim has a complete self-contained integral Mayer–Vietoris and relative-chain proof, with independent finite exact checks; bibliographic priority is not absolute and no independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns non-induced five-vertex paths as subgraphs and the color-preserving automorphism subgroup; no color-swap, modular irreducibility, or larger-path classification. The closely related 2026 preprint was accessible only through its abstract.
title: Integral equivariant homology of five-path-free complete bipartite complexes
